note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this sermon was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the shipped works' Old Testament wording the first translation carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`: allusions left in Wesley's prose, his own paraphrases, and verses he recasts to another person.

The same sermon is chapter 18 of Sermons on Several Occasions, whose Amharic shares this translation's base text; it was re-quoted first (PR #9908), and this sermon follows its OWB wording and its calls quotation for quotation, so the two stay identical. Judgement calls: Eccl 1:7 «ወንዞች ሁሉ ወደ ፈለቁበት ስፍራ» stays Wesley's line; Romans 8:11, Heb 12:2, Ps 51:5, Ps 5:9, Matt 5:29-30 and 1 Thess 5:23 are recast to another person and stay his; Romans 13:10 and 1 Tim 1:5, which the first translation ran together, are now two OWB quotations.
